title: Smallest Absent Positive Greater Than Average
summary: Given an integer array, find the smallest missing positive integer that exceeds the average of the array elements.
statement: Given an integer array, find the smallest missing positive integer that exceeds the average of the array elements.
constraints: Compute the arithmetic average of nums.
Find the smallest positive integer strictly greater than that average and absent from nums.
reference_solution:
def smallest_absent_positive_above_average(nums):
    candidate=max(1,sum(nums)//len(nums)+1)
    seen=set(nums)
    while candidate in seen:candidate+=1
    return candidate
